why: Image 1 holds together as one room lit by its own warm practicals: the dark smoked-glass sphere sits quietly in the scene, and the hard window-shaped light on the plaster wall and the floor reads like real night light. In image 2 the saturated rainbow neon rings and the coloured patch they cast on the wall look like a CG effect stuck onto the room, and the frame is softer and noisier, so it reads as a render rather than a photograph.
